card.name: Commas in injection site lists
card.fires_on: The comma (or sometimes 'into') inside a list of subcutaneous injection sites such as upper arm, thigh, or abdomen, right before the next body site is named.

modes.label: Injection site list
modes.description: Comma between body areas in a list of places to inject.
modes.example: Sites for injection include the abdomen<<,>> thigh, and back of the upper arm

modes.label: Inject into site
modes.description: The word 'into' right before the injection sites are listed.
modes.example: • Inject LEVEMIR subcutaneously<< into>> the thigh, upper arm, or abdomen

card.writes: It seems to push toward naming another body site next, though the promoted tokens look unrelated.
card.plain: It fires at the comma in lists like 'upper arm, thigh, or abdomen' in injection instructions.
